intuition: Only the nodes between left and right need their links reversed; the surrounding list can reconnect at the segment boundaries.

brute_force.approach: Copy the list values, reverse the selected slice, and rebuild a new list.

optimal.approach: Repeatedly move the node after the segment head to the segment's front using head insertion.

edge_cases: The selected segment may begin at the head.
All nodes may be included in the reversed segment.
